fields.statement: At 21a63405: go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(watchdog-health|describe-golden)$' -count=1 passed: rhiza health prints "watchdog's last actions, newest first:" with run r2 (00:02) above run r1 (00:01) and the timestamped transient-recovery line, and daemon status --json carries watchdog_actions. The journal there is a state fixture whose lines match the watchdog's real transient-recovery log format; go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestWatchdogLog -count=1 -v passed, faking a 502 transient failure through watchdogPasses over two polls: one log line per action, journalled newest first without the watchdog: prefix, with what it saw (502), what it did (resumed with --retry) and the run, a repeat replacing its entry, bounded at 20, and listed in health detail. Read the diff: daemonWatchdog wraps d.log with watchdogJournalLog, poll-behind lines are journalled too, the journal survives daemon restart (daemonStartState), and go vet is clean. The wider -run 'Watchdog|Health|DaemonStatus' run showed no test failures; it reported FAIL only because tests wrote to the enclosing ~/code/.rhiza-root, a known environment leak unrelated to this leaf.
